_help: AI WORKFLOW BLUEPRINT (shown on /ai/). Each step: label, role (Human | AI | System), text. See /docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md -> AI.
title: Lead Intake & Follow-up
description: From form submission to a prepared first conversation – without anything getting lost.

steps.label: Capture
steps.text: The funnel form sends answers to a central inbox or CRM – validated and in one structure.

steps.label: Summarise
steps.text: AI turns the answers into a short brief: need, timing, open questions.

steps.label: Route
steps.text: Rules assign the lead to the right person and create a task with a due date.

steps.label: Review
steps.text: A person checks the brief and decides on the next step.

steps.label: Follow up
steps.text: Confirmation and reminder go out on time – personal, not generic.

humanInLoop: Every lead is reviewed by a person before the first reply.
